llm.summary: This skill is purpose-aligned for reading WeChat articles, but it can navigate a browser to arbitrary URLs and installs browser tooling at runtime without enough scoping or disclosure.

dimensions.detail: A real browser is coherent for rendering WeChat pages, but unrestricted browser navigation is disproportionate because it can reach local, private, metadata, or unrelated external services from the host environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup and run paths execute npm install and npx playwright install chromium, pulling dependencies and browser binaries during normal use; this is disclosed at a high level but under-scoped and less reproducible than a fixed prerequisite/install step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions describe mp.weixin.qq.com inputs but do not require validation, confirmation, or warn that Playwright will make outbound browser requests that can expose runtime network metadata.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No backdoor, service, scheduled task, credential access, or privilege escalation was found, but the skill writes dependencies under node_modules and Chromium artifacts under the user's Playwright cache.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is extracting title and text from mp.weixin.qq.com articles, but the implementation accepts any nonempty URL and returns rendered page text, enabling use outside the declared WeChat scope.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill installing npm dependencies and Chromium, and only run it on trusted WeChat article links. It should ideally validate that inputs are exactly https://mp.weixin.qq.com URLs, block redirects to private or local networks, and move dependency/browser installation to an explicit reviewed setup step before broad use.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: Downgraded: local inspection found all listed artifact files present and readable; the unresolved reference appears to be a scanner coverage artifact rather than analysis evasion in the skill.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as a disclosure concern: outbound Playwright access is expected for the purpose, but the skill does not clearly warn about third-party requests, runtime IP/user-agent exposure, tracking, or anti-bot behavior.
[SDI-2] expected: Accepted as a proportionality concern: Playwright and Chromium are relevant, but automatic runtime npm and browser installation expands the trust boundary during routine execution.
[RP1] expected: Accepted as a supply-chain concern: npx playwright install chromium is used in setup and run paths; package-lock exists, but the runtime bootstrap path still depends on externally fetched tooling and browser artifacts.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language metadata is coherent for a WeChat public-account reader and is not a security concern by itself.
[SC1] expected: Accepted as a minor supply-chain concern: package.json uses a caret Playwright dependency, although the included package-lock reduces drift when respected.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted: scripts/extract.js forwards the supplied argument directly to page.goto without enforcing https://mp.weixin.qq.com, creating a purpose-mismatched browser navigation and local/private-network read risk.
